entities.summary: Delarivier "Delia" Manley was an English author, playwright, and political pamphleteer. Manley is sometimes referred to, with Aphra Behn and Eliza Haywood, as one of "the fair triumvirate of wit", which is a later attribution. Delarivier Manley was a authors & novelists from Q785 (1663-04-07, Q785–1724-07-11). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
